chinese_title: Hate the Player: The Ben Johnson Story
description: Hate the Player: The Ben Johnson Story is a scripted comedy from New Metric Media, the company behind Letterkenny, about the scandal of the titular Johnson, the former Canadian sprinter who went from “hero to zero in 9.79 seconds.” Johnson broke the 100m world record but was later found to have used performance enhancing drugs.

writer.name: 安东尼·Q·法雷尔 Anthony Q. Farrell
